title: The Bald Eagle river packet
summary: He recalls the reckless freight packet Bald Eagle and its rough crew, and Gene Cedric's stories of it, plus the lake excursion boats.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
